summary_ja: Open OnDemand 4.2はWCAG 2.1 AA対応、OS更新、SBOM、workflow同期key、download無効時のedit link抑止、PBSPro status対応を追加しました。4.2.3はCVE-2026-55171とCVE-2026-55169を修正しますが、OIDC利用siteがoidc_crypto_passphraseを明示しない場合、Apacheが旧設定で動き続けて緩和が適用されないsilent failureがあり得ます。HPCIの共通portalでは、upgrade成功ではなく有効設定・log・security testを受入条件にすべきです。Consensusは未完了です。
summary_en: Open OnDemand 4.2 adds WCAG 2.1 AA-oriented accessibility work, operating-system changes, an SBOM, workflow synchronization keys, edit-link suppression when downloads are disabled, and PBSPro status support. Version 4.2.3 fixes CVE-2026-55171 and CVE-2026-55169, but an OIDC site that omits an explicit oidc_crypto_passphrase can leave Apache running the old configuration, creating a silent failure in which the mitigation is not applied. A shared HPCI portal should accept effective configuration, logs, and security tests rather than package-upgrade success alone. Consensus is incomplete.

sections.title_en: Portal capabilities and security migration in Open OnDemand 4.2
sections.summary_ja: 利用性、workflow分離、data export、認証暗号設定、upgrade検証を一体で確認します。
sections.summary_en: Review usability, workflow isolation, data export, authentication cryptography, and upgrade validation together.

items.name_en: WCAG work, SBOM, workflow synchronization, and PBSPro status
items.statement_ja: 4.2.2はkeyboard navigation、label、focus、contrast、screen-reader alert等のaccessibilityを改善し、WCAG 2.1 AAのACRを公開しました。OS dependencyのSBOM、workflow実行ごとのOOD_WORKFLOW_SYNC_KEY、download_enabled=false時のedit link抑止、PBSPro cluster_info APIも追加します。Ubuntu 22.04 supportは削除され、Debian 13とUbuntu 26.04が追加されました。
items.statement_en: Version 4.2.2 improves keyboard navigation, labels, focus, contrast, and screen-reader alerts and publishes a WCAG 2.1 AA ACR. It adds an OS-dependency SBOM, a per-run OOD_WORKFLOW_SYNC_KEY, edit-link suppression when download_enabled is false, and PBSPro cluster_info support. Ubuntu 22.04 support is removed, while Debian 13 and Ubuntu 26.04 are added.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 共通portalは単なるGUIではなく、accessibility、workflow間data分離、download policy、scheduler adapter、support OSを含む運用contractとして評価します。
items.hpci_relevance_en: A shared portal should be assessed as an operational contract covering accessibility, workflow data separation, download policy, scheduler adapters, and supported operating systems rather than as a GUI alone.
adoption_conditions_ja: 各HPCI siteのOS、scheduler、authentication、interactive appをcompatibility matrix化する。
keyboard・screen reader・focusとworkflow並行実行を受入試験する。
download禁止時のeditor、terminal、notebook等の別経路を確認する。
adoption_conditions_en: Build a compatibility matrix for each HPCI site's OS, scheduler, authentication, and interactive applications.
Acceptance-test keyboard, screen-reader, focus, and concurrent workflows.
Check editor, terminal, notebook, and other paths when downloads are disabled.

items.name_ja: OIDC暗号phrase修正にsilent failureの注意
items.name_en: Silent-failure caveat in OIDC cryptographic-passphrase remediation
items.statement_ja: 4.2.3は予測可能なdefault OIDCCryptoPassphraseを廃止してCVE-2026-55171を修正します。OIDC siteがupgrade前にood_portal.ymlへoidc_crypto_passphraseを設定しない場合、Apache自体は起動しても新設定を適用できず、旧設定のまま動作して緩和が効かない可能性があります。RHELでのlog directory ownership変更に伴うCVE-2026-55169対応も、非Puppet siteではFACL更新が必要です。
items.statement_en: Version 4.2.3 removes a predictable default OIDCCryptoPassphrase to fix CVE-2026-55171. If an OIDC site does not set oidc_crypto_passphrase in ood_portal.yml before upgrade, Apache may start while failing to apply the new configuration, continuing with the old setting and leaving the mitigation ineffective. The CVE-2026-55169-related log-directory ownership change on RHEL also requires an FACL update at non-Puppet sites.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: HPCI portalのsecurity patch管理はpackage版照合だけでは不十分で、effective configurationと否定試験が必要です。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Security-patch management for HPCI portals requires effective-configuration inspection and negative testing, not package-version checks alone.
adoption_conditions_ja: stagingでOIDC login、config generation、restart、log、key rotationを試験する。
旧default phraseと未設定をconfiguration scannerで検出する。
RHEL log accessを運用者・service account・監査者ごとに確認する。
adoption_conditions_en: Test OIDC login, configuration generation, restart, logs, and key rotation in staging.
Detect the former default phrase and missing values with a configuration scanner.
Verify RHEL log access for operators, service accounts, and auditors.
